meta.title: Your Life, In Receipts
meta.subtitle: One person. Thousands of moments. One continuous story.

chapters.title: The Body Remembers
chapters.description: A cluster of medical expenses around mid-2018 — cataract medicines, dentist visits, lab tests. The quiet cost of taking care of oneself while life continues.

chapters.title: Quiet Ambition
chapters.description: Regular transfers into PPF, mutual funds, and small-cap funds. While daily life spent on milk and trains, another self was steadily building a future.

chapters.title: The Small Repeating Days
chapters.description: Half-litre milk, cutting chai, poha, kachori. The receipts that appear almost every day. These are the true heartbeat of a life.

chapters.title: Belonging
chapters.description: Ganesh idol, Navratri, pocket money, farewell contributions. The moments money was spent not for the self but for connection.

chapters.title: Always Moving
chapters.description: Trains between places, autos, Ola cabs to the eye institute, taxis after dinner. A life measured in journeys between stations.

chapters.title: The First Soundtrack
chapters.description: Lana Del Rey, John Mayer, MGMT, Arctic Monkeys. The music of late nights and open questions. A young listener finding the songs that felt like home.
chapters.insight: 1,364 meaningful plays in the early years

chapters.title: Expanding Horizons
chapters.description: The taste widens. Classic rock, new voices, deeper cuts. Music becomes both comfort and exploration.

chapters.title: Still Listening
chapters.description: The same artists return, new ones appear. John Mayer still plays. The music has become a companion across more than a decade.

chapters.title: Songs at 2 AM
chapters.description: When the rest of the world sleeps, certain songs keep company. These are the tracks that filled the quietest hours.
